categories.name: Rotate & Tilt
categories.description: Rotation and tilt-based transforms applied to the image on hover.

effects.name: Rotate Clockwise
effects.description: Rotates the image 15 degrees clockwise on hover.

effects.name: Rotate Counter-Clockwise
effects.description: Rotates the image 15 degrees counter-clockwise on hover.

effects.name: Tilt Left
effects.description: Tilts the image 8 degrees to the left on hover.

effects.name: Tilt Right
effects.description: Tilts the image 8 degrees to the right on hover.

effects.name: Tilt Up
effects.description: Tilts the image backward (top edge away) with 3D perspective on hover.

effects.name: Tilt Down
effects.description: Tilts the image forward (top edge toward viewer) with 3D perspective on hover.

effects.name: Tilt Top-Left
effects.description: Tilts the image 8 degrees from its top-left corner on hover.

effects.name: Tilt Top-Right
effects.description: Tilts the image 8 degrees from its top-right corner on hover.

effects.name: Tilt Bottom-Left
effects.description: Tilts the image 8 degrees from its bottom-left corner on hover.

effects.name: Tilt Bottom-Right
effects.description: Tilts the image 8 degrees from its bottom-right corner on hover.

categories.name: Skew & Distort
categories.description: Skew transformations and asymmetric scaling effects applied to the image on hover.

effects.name: Horizontal Skew
effects.description: Skews the image horizontally by 15 degrees on hover.

effects.name: Vertical Skew
effects.description: Skews the image vertically by 15 degrees on hover.

effects.name: Skew Left
effects.description: Skews the image toward the left on hover.

effects.name: Skew Right
effects.description: Skews the image toward the right on hover.

effects.name: Skew Top
effects.description: Skews the image toward the top on hover.

effects.name: Skew Bottom
effects.description: Skews the image toward the bottom on hover.

effects.name: Perspective Skew
effects.description: Applies a 3D perspective skew and rotateY to the image on hover.

effects.name: Horizontal Stretch
effects.description: Stretches the image wider on hover (scale 1.4, 1.2).

effects.name: Vertical Stretch
effects.description: Stretches the image taller on hover (scale 1.2, 1.4).

effects.name: Compress
effects.description: Image starts enlarged and compresses to its original size on hover.

categories.name: 3D & Perspective
categories.description: 3D perspective transforms applied to the image on hover.

effects.name: 3D Perspective Zoom
effects.description: Zooms the image forward in 3D space (translateZ 60px) on hover.

effects.name: Flip Horizontal
effects.description: Flips the image around the Y-axis (mirror flip) on hover.

effects.name: Flip Vertical
effects.description: Flips the image around the X-axis (upside-down) on hover.

effects.name: Rotate X
effects.description: Rotates the image 25 degrees around the X-axis on hover.

effects.name: Rotate Y
effects.description: Rotates the image 25 degrees around the Y-axis on hover.

effects.name: 3D Tilt
effects.description: Tilts the image in 3D space on both axes on hover.

effects.name: 3D Lift
effects.description: Lifts the image forward toward the viewer on hover.

effects.name: 3D Push
effects.description: Pushes the image back away from the viewer on hover.

effects.name: Perspective Shift
effects.description: Shifts the image laterally in 3D space on hover.

effects.name: Card-like 3D
effects.description: Tilts the image like a physical card in 3D space on hover.

categories.name: Border & Frame
categories.description: Decorative borders and frames that appear around the image on hover.

effects.name: Border Reveal
effects.description: A solid border fades in around the image on hover.

effects.name: Animated Frame
effects.description: An animated gradient ring orbits around the image on hover.

effects.name: Corner Frame
effects.description: L-shaped corner brackets fade in at each corner of the image on hover.

effects.name: Inset Frame
effects.description: An inset shadow border appears inside the image edges on hover.

effects.name: Expanding Frame
effects.description: An outer border expands outward from the image on hover.

categories.name: Shadow & Depth
categories.description: Box-shadow effects that suggest depth and elevation on hover.

effects.name: Shadow Reveal
effects.description: A drop shadow appears beneath the image on hover.

effects.name: Press Depth
effects.description: Image appears to press down with a growing inset shadow on hover.

effects.name: Glow
effects.description: A violet halo glow appears around the image on hover.

effects.name: Directional Shadow
effects.description: A directional drop shadow appears beneath the image on hover.

categories.name: Overlay
categories.description: Translucent color overlays that fade, slide, or split across the image on hover.

effects.name: Solid Overlay
effects.description: A solid dark overlay fades in on hover.

effects.name: Gradient Overlay
effects.description: A dark gradient fades in from top on hover.

effects.name: Directional Overlay
effects.description: A blue overlay slides in from the left on hover.

effects.name: Split Overlay
effects.description: Two colored halves close in from opposite sides on hover.

effects.name: Reveal Overlay
effects.description: A dark overlay slides up to reveal the image on hover.

categories.name: Reveal
categories.description: Mask-based reveals using clip-path, border-radius, or split animations on hover.

effects.name: Circle Reveal
effects.description: A circular clip-path recedes to reveal the image on hover.

effects.name: Circle Conceal
effects.description: A circular clip-path grows to conceal the image on hover.

effects.name: Inset Reveal
effects.description: An inset clip-path expands inward to reveal the image on hover.

effects.name: Wipe Reveal
effects.description: A clip-path wipes from left to right to reveal the image on hover.

effects.name: Diagonal Reveal
effects.description: A clip-path triangle recedes to reveal the image on hover.

effects.name: Corner Reveal
effects.description: A clip-path corner recedes to reveal the image on hover.

effects.name: Horizontal Split
effects.description: Image splits into two halves that separate horizontally on hover.

effects.name: Vertical Split
effects.description: Image splits into two halves that separate vertically on hover.

effects.name: Diamond Reveal
effects.description: A diamond clip-path reveals the image on hover.

effects.name: Rounded Reveal
effects.description: A growing border-radius reveals the image on hover.

categories.name: Zoom
categories.description: Scale-based image zoom effects on hover.

effects.name: Point Zoom
effects.description: Zooms the image toward a specific anchor point on hover.

effects.name: Quick Zoom
effects.description: A fast scale-up on hover.

effects.name: Zoom In
effects.description: A subtle scale-up on hover.

effects.name: Zoom Out
effects.description: A subtle scale-down on hover.

effects.name: Zoom Top
effects.description: Zooms toward the top of the image on hover.

effects.name: Zoom Bottom
effects.description: Zooms toward the bottom of the image on hover.

effects.name: Zoom Left
effects.description: Zooms toward the left of the image on hover.

effects.name: Zoom Right
effects.description: Zooms toward the right of the image on hover.

effects.name: Zoom Top Left
effects.description: Zooms toward the top-left of the image on hover.

effects.name: Zoom Top Right
effects.description: Zooms toward the top-right of the image on hover.

effects.name: Zoom Bottom Left
effects.description: Zooms toward the bottom-left of the image on hover.

effects.name: Zoom Bottom Right
effects.description: Zooms toward the bottom-right of the image on hover.

categories.name: Pan & Move
categories.description: Translate-based pan effects paired with a slight scale-up on hover.

effects.name: Pan Left
effects.description: Pans the image left while slightly scaling up on hover.

effects.name: Pan Right
effects.description: Pans the image right while slightly scaling up on hover.

effects.name: Pan Top
effects.description: Pans the image up while slightly scaling up on hover.

effects.name: Pan Bottom
effects.description: Pans the image down while slightly scaling up on hover.

effects.name: Pan Top Left
effects.description: Pans the image toward the top-left while slightly scaling up on hover.

effects.name: Pan Top Right
effects.description: Pans the image toward the top-right while slightly scaling up on hover.

effects.name: Pan Bottom Left
effects.description: Pans the image toward the bottom-left while slightly scaling up on hover.

effects.name: Pan Bottom Right
effects.description: Pans the image toward the bottom-right while slightly scaling up on hover.

effects.name: Pan Center
effects.description: Slightly scales the image up on hover (no pan).

categories.name: Fade
categories.description: Opacity-based fade effects applied to the image or an overlay on hover.

effects.name: Fade In
effects.description: Image starts transparent and fades in to full opacity on hover.

effects.name: Fade Out
effects.description: Image fades from full opacity to transparent on hover.

effects.name: Fade to Color
effects.description: Image fades to transparent revealing a colored background on hover.

effects.name: Fade Overlay
effects.description: A semi-transparent dark overlay fades in on hover.

effects.name: Fade Overlay Dark
effects.description: A dark overlay fades in on hover.

effects.name: Fade Overlay Light
effects.description: A light overlay fades in on hover.

effects.name: Fade Caption
effects.description: A caption overlay fades in over the image on hover.

effects.name: Fade Crossfade
effects.description: Image crossfades to a duplicate image on hover.

effects.name: Fade Blur
effects.description: Image fades to a blurred state on hover.

categories.name: Slide & Reveal
categories.description: Width/height-driven slide-in and cover animations on hover.

effects.name: Slide Reveal Left
effects.description: A left-anchored overlay slides left to reveal the image on hover.

effects.name: Slide Reveal Right
effects.description: A right-anchored overlay slides right to reveal the image on hover.

effects.name: Slide Reveal Top
effects.description: A top-anchored overlay slides up to reveal the image on hover.

effects.name: Slide Reveal Bottom
effects.description: A bottom-anchored overlay slides down to reveal the image on hover.

effects.name: Slide Reveal Top Left
effects.description: A top-left-anchored overlay slides diagonally to reveal the image on hover.

effects.name: Slide Reveal Top Right
effects.description: A top-right-anchored overlay slides diagonally to reveal the image on hover.

effects.name: Slide Reveal Bottom Left
effects.description: A bottom-left-anchored overlay slides diagonally to reveal the image on hover.

effects.name: Slide Reveal Bottom Right
effects.description: A bottom-right-anchored overlay slides diagonally to reveal the image on hover.

effects.name: Slide Cover Left
effects.description: A dark overlay slides in from the left to cover the image on hover.

effects.name: Slide Cover Right
effects.description: A dark overlay slides in from the right to cover the image on hover.

effects.name: Slide Cover Top
effects.description: A dark overlay slides in from the top to cover the image on hover.

effects.name: Slide Cover Bottom
effects.description: A dark overlay slides in from the bottom to cover the image on hover.

categories.name: Blur & Focus
categories.description: Blur transitions on hover (image starts blurred and sharpens, or vice versa).

effects.name: Blur In
effects.description: Image starts blurred and sharpens on hover.

effects.name: Blur Out
effects.description: Image starts sharp and softens into a blurred state on hover.

categories.name: Color & Filters
categories.description: Color filter effects on hover (grayscale, sepia, invert, hue rotate, etc.).

effects.name: Grayscale
effects.description: Removes color from the image on hover.

effects.name: Colorize
effects.description: Applies a colored hue-rotate and saturation boost on hover.

effects.name: Sepia
effects.description: Applies a sepia tone to the image on hover.

effects.name: Hue Rotate
effects.description: Rotates the hue of the image by 180 degrees on hover.

effects.name: Saturate
effects.description: Increases color saturation on hover.

effects.name: Desaturate to Color
effects.description: Image starts grayscale and returns to full color on hover.

effects.name: Invert
effects.description: Inverts the image colors on hover.

effects.name: Warm Tone
effects.description: Applies a warm sepia-and-saturate tone on hover.

effects.name: Cool Tone
effects.description: Applies a cool hue-rotated tone on hover.

categories.name: Brightness & Contrast
categories.description: Brightness and contrast adjustments on hover.

effects.name: Brighten
effects.description: Brightens the image on hover.

effects.name: Darken
effects.description: Darkens the image on hover.

effects.name: Contrast Increase
effects.description: Increases image contrast on hover.

effects.name: Contrast Decrease
effects.description: Decreases image contrast on hover.

effects.name: Brighten to Normal
effects.description: Image starts darkened and brightens to normal on hover.

effects.name: Darken to Normal
effects.description: Image starts brightened and darkens to normal on hover.

effects.name: Contrast to Normal
effects.description: Image starts low-contrast and returns to normal on hover.

effects.name: High-Contrast Focus
effects.description: Image sharpens with high contrast when focused (keyboard accessible).
